notes: Cai dat: tai file HPCONS-BIM-Setup-2.0.76.exe ben duoi, DONG Revit roi chay (can quyen Admin). - O cao do: neu vi tri mac dinh (duoi ten phong) de len ghi chu / ky hieu khac thi tu doi xuong, len tren ten phong hoac sang ngang. O cua phong nao luon nam trong phong do, tren dung mat san, ky hieu vat lieu khong roi vao tuong. - Ky hieu cua di, cua so: giu dung phia (cua di phia trong, cua so phia ngoai), truot trong pham vi be rong cua roi lui xa tuong dan. - Thu tu dat: tag phong -> o cao do -> ky hieu cua -> tag vach; cai dat sau tranh cai dat truoc. - Phong nho kin chu (WC 4-5 m2) khong con cho trong: van dat o vi tri mac dinh va bao "can keo tay" trong bao cao.
